scope: Specification only; not a runtime schema, reducer, renderer, event store or implemented telemetry API. S03-S07 own implementation.
identityLimitation: Project visual-identity skill absent; existing design documents and tokens.css are authoritative. Only the resolved ponytail skill was activated; other Phase 1 user skills were not available within this unit's permitted read paths. No other checkout or unverified skill reconstruction.

glyphs.phaseTicks: five radial ticks at 0,72,144,216,288 degrees; radii 0.74 to 0.82

geometry.renderRule: Keep ring and static glyph at every size. Dot is replaced by the state glyph except phaseTicks, which keeps the dot. Up to three concentric level rings at radii 0.62,0.70,0.78; all scale by 1+0.12*y only during fresh confirmed output. Clamp extent including stroke to 0.9. No random geometry or audio-like decorative jitter.

identity.motionUnits: period/transition/hold in ms; amplitude/scale are dimensionless fractions of base geometry. Breath scale=1+a*(1-cos(2*pi*t/period))/2; rotate ring only clockwise 360*t/period degrees; glyph stays upright. Period zero disables that motion. Elements budget counts grouped vector primitives: compound glyph/ticks one group; essential glyph/label never dropped.

transition.rule: State, label, terminal fence and zero-level changes are immediate; durations affect decorative transforms only. Interrupt current transition from its current transform, never queue animations.

states.label: Idle
states.trigger: Authoritative idle/ready/sentinel snapshot or end of activity with no other active fact.
states.exit: Current listening, work, activation or connection fact.

states.label: Listening
states.cue: 270 degree open arc and leading tick
states.trigger: Core capture/listening lifecycle fact; never inferred from microphone amplitude or sentinel clap input.
states.exit: Capture ends, work starts, cancellation, error or disconnect.

states.label: Thinking
states.cue: dashed ring and three fixed dots
states.trigger: Legacy processing or current correlated agent.started; generated speech may supply static 'Speech prepared; output unconfirmed' detail, never measured speaking.
states.exit: Work outcome, explicit execution fact, confirmed output or other authoritative activity.

states.label: Speaking
states.cue: concentric ring and fixed three-bar glyph
states.trigger: Proposed current device-write-confirmed speech playback AND fresh normalized output sample for the same session/generation/playback.
states.audibility: Confirms successful output writes, not physical audibility or final DAC drain. Fresh zero samples are silence during an active stream: target zero, envelope releases to rest.
states.exit: Playback end/cancel/failure, missing or stale telemetry, stop or disconnect. Fallback is static underlying activity, not SPEAKING.

states.label: Executing
states.trigger: Legacy executing presentation value or proposed typed Core tool-execution start; never arbitrary agent.progress detail text.
states.exit: Matching command/agent terminal outcome, cancel, failure or disconnect.

states.label: Done
states.trigger: Matching uncancelled command.executed ok=true or agent.completed ok=true after aggregate error checks. Startup ready uses Ready text, not inferred app success.
states.exit: 900 ms elapsed or any higher priority active fact; never replay a hidden or expired success.

states.label: Error
states.cue: broken 300 degree ring and warning triangle
states.trigger: Correlated uncancelled failed command/agent outcome, actual output failure, startup failed, or legacy error. Startup degraded is partial status, not necessarily a fatal error.
states.exit: Recoverable error hold ends after 1500 ms; persistent device/startup failure stays static until explicit recovery or a new authoritative generation. Stop/disconnect preempt immediately.

states.label: Offline
states.trigger: Initial/absent transport, connection loss, invalid or missing authoritative snapshot, or legacy offline.
states.exit: Validated fresh snapshot from connected Core; reconnect alone is insufficient.

states.label: Starting
states.cue: solid ring with five fixed phase ticks and central dot
states.trigger: Activation candidate/confirmation or nonterminal startup phase. Ring/ticks settle per actual phase; not elapsed-time progress.
states.exit: Startup ready/degraded/failed/cancelled or disconnect; candidate expiry returns IDLE without stopping an unrelated session.

states.label: Stopping
states.cue: solid ring and two stop bars
states.trigger: Confirmed session stop or startup cancelled; do not infer completion from a sleep request acknowledgement.
states.exit: Authoritative cleanup/sentinel snapshot then IDLE, or disconnect. No cosmetic timeout asserts cleanup.

speaking.requires: fresh device-write-confirmed playback and level; otherwise static THINKING with output-unconfirmed detail

sourceMappings.fact: VoiceModelManager publishes model residency, not Core capture/execution state. Keep as model detail, not direct assistant aliases.
Sets RuntimeState.THINKING internally and publishes agent.started after routing. RuntimeState is not itself the voice.state channel.
Protocol permits free-text detail; no typed executing phase exists. Show detail only; never parse into executable content or infer execution.

Carry trace_id and ok. Failed command can precede agent.completed ok=true for a successfully handled turn; preserve the failure, never overwrite with aggregate success. agent.completed ok=false can mean cancellation; apply fence first.
Generated chunk/cache orchestration; coverage gaps for speak_text and welcomes. Not device proof; generated completion does not end a confirmed playback stream.

variants.layout: Core + adjacent label, reserved one-line ellipsized caption. Controls never covered. Full text in expanded view; no auto expansion from level.
Proposed reference size, not a native resize change. Core header, captions, scrollable focusable conversation, existing expand/collapse/hide controls.
Within AssistantStatus slot only; preserve eight workspace links, command palette, skip link, scroll/focus and right rail behavior.
No new window or modal. On overlay host inherit its core size, scale, stroke and element budget; startup overrides content only. Phase text and unknown app outcomes stay visible.

staticIdentity: Graphite surface, radius 0.62 ring, central state glyph. Required glyph/label persist without motion, glow or color. Offline token is decorative only; slash and all text use text-primary for contrast.
layoutPolicy: Dimensions are CSS px/DIPs reference budgets, not device pixels. Fit square without distortion, drop optional rings/glow first, never shrink text or targets. Preserve existing native draggable/control regions and pass-through focus ownership; core is aria-hidden decoration beside accessible status. No interactive island is added. Text can wrap in expanded view; zoom/high DPI must not clip captions or controls.

rules: Reject invalid identity/order and apply terminal fences before selecting highest-priority currently active fact, not the highest historical event.
DISCONNECTED outranks SPEAKING and immediately clears levels; new connection needs snapshot before re-entry.
Turn/playback cancellation fences discard later starts, amplitude and success/error outcomes for the cancelled identity; a new playback ID cannot bypass a cancelled turn generation.
Session stop fences the whole session; candidate expiry fences only that activation candidate, not a concurrent unrelated turn.
Matching terminal outcomes clear active work; hold clocks start at receipt, are not extended by duplicates and expire while hidden. Critical errors persist until recovery.
Startup announcing remains STARTING with welcome detail; confirmed welcome amplitude can modulate rings but cannot hide startup progress or partial status.

lifecycle.status: All identity/snapshot/output contracts below are proposed downstream policies, absent from today's v1 envelope (v,ts,mono_ms). Names below are conceptual inputs, not promised wire names.

acceptedInputs.provenance: orchestration; cancelled=true is a turn cancellation hint, not device drain
healthy report; welcome_source/timings, not audible proof
issues and phase; announcing may continue
accepted activation; configurable clap count or other source
candidate expiry; not proof active session stopped
handled turn outcome; cancellation/error aggregation required
tool result, no start or arguments
Core capture/tool/stop lifecycle plus session/generation/trace correlation
Python successful device-write start, ended/cancelled/failed; never queue played counter
Python gain-adjusted written speech PCM RMS/peak, no browser inference
authoritative Core state with watermark, terminal fences, startup/app facts and output age

identity.session: Opaque Core session/boot identity; changes on replacement. Only snapshot establishes a new session.
identity.generation: Nonnegative safe integer, increments for each turn or startup activation; trace_id correlates existing events. Candidate ID is separate from an active turn.
identity.playback: Opaque unique output instance within generation; required for output, null for non-output work. New playback requires accepted start under a live generation.
identity.ordering: Nonnegative safe integer sequence strictly increases across one session stream, shared by lifecycle/output/snapshot watermark. Duplicates and lower sequences dropped without refreshing freshness; gaps request snapshot, suppress speaking until reconciled. Valid envelopes advance observed watermark even when their fenced payload is ignored; trace acceptedSequences means applied state changes, not observed envelopes.
identity.fences: Terminal generation/session fences retained until authoritative replacement; playback end fences that playback. Retired session packets cannot recreate state. Unmapped legacy trace events may show static detail, never invent identity or measured speech.

snapshot.rule: Install atomic state, pending/failed app outcomes, terminal fences and sequence watermark. Drop packets <= watermark. Snapshot has authoritative age; cannot mark old amplitude fresh on delivery. Missing/invalid snapshot stays DISCONNECTED with 'State unavailable'. No browser endpoint or polling API is added here.

freshness.clock: Python monotonic capture age plus bridge transit age and local monotonic elapsed; never subtract independent process clock origins or wall-clock ts. Negative/nonfinite/future age invalid.
freshness.stateRule: Lifecycle facts persist until matching terminal/recovery within live session. Silence is not disconnection. Proposed liveness timeout or failed transport requires a new snapshot, not repeated activate.
freshness.onStale: At age >250ms clear level/peak/gate to zero, stop audio transforms and show static underlying activity with 'Output telemetry unavailable', not SPEAKING.
freshness.onAbsent: Static underlying THINKING/IDLE/STARTING with truthful output-unconfirmed detail; no fake production speech, no fallback sine wave. Unknown cancellation/outcome correlation stays static with outcome-unconfirmed detail, not a guessed ERROR or SUCCESS. Invalid levels never refresh last-valid sample age.

audio.status: Proposed S05 policy, not available telemetry; successful write is not human/device-acoustic acceptance.

level.invalid: Reject non-number/NaN/Infinity before arithmetic; finite out-of-range values clamp to [0,1] with level-invalid diagnostic.
level.normalization: Python decodes actual WAV metadata, int16 divided by 32768 or bounded float PCM; apply actual output gain, compute RMS per channel over <=40ms successful device-write window, then max channel RMS. No AGC or per-window max normalization; 1 means digital full scale, not loudness or microphone SPL.

noiseGate.rule: Closed opens at >=open; open closes at <=close; between thresholds retain gate. Target is zero while closed, else clamped RMS.

smoothing.rule: tau=attack when gated target x>y, else release. Invalid/negative dt gives no step; clamp large valid dt, but freshness/reset wins first. No frame-count assumption.

peak.rule: Python max absolute gain-adjusted written sample per window. Hold maximum 120ms then release with 220ms tau; never raise RMS envelope from peak. Same invalid/clamp/freshness/reset rules. Peak detail optional, no extra flash.

cadence.rule: Coalesce newest level off audio thread; no per-sample EventHub publication. At most one frame callback per visible window; no React setState per frame. Reduced/disabled modes redraw on semantic state/phase only, not every level. Python off-audio-thread coalescer computes envelope once per accepted sample using monotonic sample dt. Windows consume the same RMS/peak/envelope facts, interpolate at most 60Hz without re-smoothing, and do no independent PCM analysis. Hidden renderers resume from current envelope/snapshot with local interpolation reset.

audio.ownership: PCM, input capture and output device remain Python-owned. No browser microphone, AudioContext analyser, new transport or independent window audio processing. Mute, music/browser fallback and device failure must not synthesize levels.

examples.name: end
examples.note: Fresh zero tail samples during active stream; actual terminal end resets to zero immediately.

startup.timingAuthority: StartupOptions/config in Python. Cached healthy welcome targets music_started + welcome_delay_seconds (default 2s), duck starts early; services/health may delay it. Live/fallback use voice readiness/announcement deadlines, not that delay. UI adds no two-second timer.

phases.note: Default two-clap path: first clap only speculates voice, no chime/music. Count configurable; hotkey/wake/control can bypass candidate.
Existing activation sound or synthesized cue. first_sound mark is not audible proof.
Services and workspace launched concurrently before awaiting local music/browser URL fallback; music_started mark is not confirmed output. App outcome remains unknown until reported.
Existing prerecorded healthy cache or live/degraded/fallback welcome. Without output telemetry show phase text and static identity; no fabricated welcome amplitude.
Core health only; app launch not inferred successful. Actual capture input can then select LISTENING.
Persistent partial-status text/issues channel; fatal required failure selects ERROR. startup.degraded at announcing updates issues without terminating startup.
Static persistent failure until recovery; retain available controls.
Wait for authoritative cleanup; already launched apps keep running. Candidate activation.cancelled alone returns IDLE.

startup.phaseTicks: Five milestones: candidate/confirmed, acknowledged, initializing, announcing, terminal. Ticks are categorical, not percent or five serial tasks. Direct activation skips candidate. No cosmetic elapsed-time advancement.
startup.apps: Workspace starts concurrently. StartupReport.workspace contains per-app status/ms/detail or error, but existing SSE startup.progress has phase only. Proposed snapshot may supply sanitized outcomes; until then show 'Apps: status unavailable', never an invented apps phase or all apps ready. App failures do not imply rollback or close launched apps.

sequences.description: Actual phases drive at most 320ms ring/tick settles; welcome modulation requires confirmed fresh speech output; music uses phase text only. No forced cinematic wait.
Instant static ticks/glyph and phase text; no loops, audio geometry or camera movement. Runtime timing unchanged.
Shortens decorative transitions only, not Python startup/music/welcome or service deadlines. OS reduce/disabled wins.

Text-complete presentation when output is actually silent/muted/unavailable. No startup mute option/API exists here; do not equate music_volume=0 with muted welcome. Only authoritative existing output/config status can label muted; unknown status says unconfirmed. Fixture selection never sends mute.
Existing sleep/sequence.cancel requests may interrupt music/welcome; confirm stop, fence old generation, zero level, STOPPING until cleanup. No new stop control; request acceptance is not completion.

adjustable.rule: Proposed local presentation preference only. Multiplies listed amplitudes and decorative transition durations, capped at 320ms; never speeds loops or overrides OS reduce. No settings UI/store added here.

motionPolicy.reduced: Zero transition duration; no continuous rotation, breath, envelope-driven geometry or glow pulse. Semantic glyph/label changes only.
motionPolicy.disabled: Same recognizable static geometry, no animation or amplitude redraw; current state/phase text remains.

flash.note: No deliberate flashes, strobes or alternating full-field luminance. Frame/update cadence is not a flash rate; do not limit labels or telemetry to three updates per second.

motionPolicy.cues: All states have distinct static glyph plus label; never color alone. text-primary essential glyph/label on neutral graphite; offline color decorative. Downstream must measure >=4.5:1 text and >=3:1 essential nontext at all sizes; no contrast pass is claimed here.

announcements.rule: One shared semantic announcer, deduplicate, latest pending status only; no waveform/sample announcements. Captions remain visible and independent. Persistent failures must not be lost to transient work detail.

motionPolicy.hiddenWindow: Stop RAF and animation, coalesce latest semantic facts, expire holds and validate fences; no hidden level work/backlog. On visible fetch/install current snapshot and reset local interpolation, not shared envelope; no catch-up animation or startup replay.
